item.title: Watch! Protecting the Ones You Love: Legal & Insurance Tools for ME/CFS Caregivers - Solve ME/CFS Initiative
item.description: Watch our webinar for caregivers and learn essential legal and insurance strategies to support a loved one living with ME/CFS.

item.title: Advocacy Update: Three Crucial ME/CFS Federal Budget Wins - Solve ME/CFS Initiative
item.description: Solve M.E. Director of Advocacy Monique Wike reports that the government has committed to keeping key ME/CFS research and public health programs alive, protecting pathways for new research funding, and directing the NIH to spell out how it will move toward real tests and treatments.

item.title: This Week in “What’s New in ME/CFS?”: A Q&A with Dr. Hector Bonilla - Solve ME/CFS Initiative
item.description: Dr. Hector Bonilla (Clinical Professor at Stanford and Co-Director of the Stanford ME/CFS and Long COVID Clinics) discusses how emerging science is reshaping our understanding of ME/CFS.

item.title: New Catalyst Awards to Accelerate ME/CFS and Long Covid Breakthroughs - Solve ME/CFS Initiative
item.description: Solve announces ME/CFS Catalyst Awards for two new groundbreaking studies to advance urgently needed treatment and diagnostic research for ME/CFS and Long Covid.

item.title: Welcoming Jessica Maya, PhD, Solve M.E.’s New Vice President of Scientific Programs - Solve ME/CFS Initiative
item.description: Solve's new VP of Scientific Programs, Dr. Jessica Maya, has a background in immunology, genetics, and infection-associated chronic illness research, and served in the Chronic Viral Diseases Branch at the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention.

item.title: Registration Open for ME/CFS Advocacy Week 2026 - Solve ME/CFS Initiative
item.description: This year, we'll foster relationships with state-level patient safety and medical boards to encourage them to push for inclusion of ME/CFS in medical school curriculum and on national qualifying medical exams.

item.title: Join the Fight for Federal Research Funding and Medical Education for ME/CFS - Solve ME/CFS Initiative
item.description: We are asking Congress to take meaningful action on three fronts this year -- the CDC's ME/CFS program, ME/CFS as an eligible topic in the PRMRP, and the NIH's ME/CFS Research Roadmap.

item.title: Recognizing Long Covid Awareness Day: Resources for You - Solve ME/CFS Initiative
item.description: To mark Long Covid Awareness Day, Solve has joined forces with #MEAction, Bateman Horne Center, and the Open Medicine Foundation as #UnitedForME and gathered a set of resources designed to inform and empower patients, caregivers, and supporters.

item.title: A Quick Guide to Advocacy Week 2026 - Solve ME/CFS Initiative
item.description: March 23–27, we're reaching out to the Patient Safety Agencies, State Medical Boards, State Health Leadership, and Chief Medical Officers who have the institutional authority to make that recommendation. We're asking them to use it.

item.title: Advocacy Week Starts Monday and This Year is Different - Solve ME/CFS Initiative
item.description: For Advocacy Week 2026, we're working with the systems that shape what medical providers in America learn.
